source_evidence: Exact player 'after essential live make no sense, we need solid laws' rejects the previous subjective deduction for essential living expenses and requests clear enforceable proposed tax laws. Voss removes discretionary living-expense deductions. Revised DRAFT Vaishnavi Tax Code: Article I annual taxable household income consists of wages/salaries, commercial profits, rental income and earned compensation (including in-kind compensation at agreed documented coin value). Businesses may deduct documented direct operating costs of earning revenue (materials, employee wages, freight, commercial rent, ordinary business upkeep), no personal food/housing/clothing/entertainment/living deduction, no loans, owner capital or own-account transfers treated as income, no double count. Household = jointly maintained family economic unit including dependents, separate independent earners/lodgers not aggregated merely by co-residence; each taxpayer's income appears once. Article II retains proposed marginal rates first50gp exempt, 50–150gp 5%, 150–400gp 10%, 400–1000gp 15%, above1000gp20%. Example taxable200gp owes10gp; taxable600gp owes60gp. Article III single coin-denominated liability may be discharged with coin/equivalent agreed goods, freely chosen actual performed labor credited at established wage (0.6/1/2/5/12gp per appropriate day), or voluntary lawful compensated blood contributions credited at actual agreed coin compensation under a written, published contract; no established blood rate or recipient, no compulsory feeding, no magical compulsion, consent freely revocable, independent healer oversight, no tax penalty for choosing another method. Article IV proposed fiscal period360 campaign days, four 90-day cumulative settlements with amounts previously paid/credited deducted, final annual reconciliation; no retroactive levy, itemized receipts and review, no arbitrary collector adjustments, no imprisonment or forced bodily service for inability to pay; documented payment plan available. First50gp fixed exemption supersedes subjective living-cost deduction; any future relief must be separately defined in law, not personal collector preference. These are draft legal terms, including DM-proposed fiscal period and examples, not enacted tax authority, rates approved by player, policy applied, blood tariff, new revenue or expense. Crown taxes/estate tax commitments and legal limits remain intact; no power over ungranted district or unrelated inhabitants. Earlier migration incentives remain unapproved; Voss appointed as before. No movement/rest/resource changes; Day335~15:44, zero supplies, V next choice. No RNG for drafting and voluntary discussion.
